name: prism-designframe
description:
Designframe — minimalist adaptive design system by Mike Prasad.
Built as a Tailwind CSS preset/extension; pure CSS output.

lossiness.description: DF combo-class behavior captured as prose only; v2's compositions/ layer fixes this.
DF block hierarchy grammar (MAIN > SECTION > BLOCKS > Content) is captured as prose only.
DF adaptive stack behavior is approximated by Tailwind responsive utilities; stack behavior at breakpoints is not preserved 1:1.
DF's semantic-HTML mandates are captured as prose only, not validated by Prism's lint.
DESIGN.md has no mode-overlay system; emitter is light-mode + base theme only.
DESIGN.md ecosystem expects MD3 naming; emitter applies a crosswalk.
DF stores colors as space-separated RGB triplets; DTCG output normalizes to hex.

brandCustomization.rule: Tokens with $brand-owned=true are intended to be replaced when consumers fork. $system-owned=true tokens are stable across all consumers.
brandCustomization.note: Brand/system classification derived from PRISM.md frontmatter brandOwnedRoots + systemOwnedRoots.

rationale.note: Section order canonical per Google DESIGN.md convention.
